name: filter-popover
title: Filter popover
description: A Filters button with a count that opens a panel of grouped options: choices are staged and applied together, with Reset and a live result count.
docs: Pass groups, each { id, label, kind } with kind checkbox or radio (options of { value, label, count, disabled }, and defaultValue for the option that means no filter), range ({ min, max, step, prefix, suffix }) or toggle ({ description }), value (the applied filters) and onApply(next), which receives only the groups that are on: checkbox lists of values, a radio value, a range as [min, max], a toggle as true. The button reads Filters with a badge counting the groups that are on, and opens a panel where every change is a draft: closing it with Escape or a click outside throws the draft away, and it starts from the applied value each time. Groups fold, the first and every group with something chosen start open, and a closed group says what is chosen in it. A checkbox or radio list with more than eight options gets a search field and scrolls inside itself, and in the popover Escape in that field empties it first and closes the panel only when it is already empty (a sheet around FilterPanel has to ask the same of its own Escape handler). A range is a slider with two number fields: a field takes what was typed when it is left or Enter is pressed, never a digit at a time, the smaller of the two numbers becomes the minimum, and an empty field leaves its end of the range open; the arrow keys and the spinner of a field step at once and stop at the other end of the range. Focus starts on the first group, not on Reset. Reset empties the draft and calls onReset; it stays focusable when it has nothing to do. The one button at the foot names what it will do: with resultCount(draft), sync or async, it counts as the draft changes (the first count at once, later ones after a short pause, late answers dropped) and says Show 128 results, Show results while the first count is on its way, and No results, switched off with a hint, when nothing would be left; without it, Apply 3 filters, Apply filters or Clear filters. Apply calls onApply when something changed, closes the panel, returns focus to the button and announces 3 filters applied in a live region that outlives the panel. At 320 pixels the panel stays inside the window and scrolls inside itself. trigger replaces the button, locale writes the numbers and plurals, and labels translates every word. FilterPanel (from the item's panel file) is the same panel without the popover, for a sheet on a phone.
